name: Koillection
description: Keep track of your collections, from books and games to stamps

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The built-in PostgreSQL database, the secrets and the API keys. Back it up.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Pictures and files you add to your collections. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Koillection web app and API, published on host as 7001

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: HTTPS_ENABLED
variables.description: 0 for plain http at your MOS address. Set 1 only behind a reverse proxy with https, or sign-in stops working.
